items.title: Charles Calello interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, July 21, 2025
items.q: And I love Bruno Mars. So I worked on the arrangement for three weeks until I came up with the idea. ... it was something like I said I don't have it yet.

ctx.x: Do you have to step away sometimes and go do something else? Go for a walk and let your head work the thing out on its own?

Well I recently did another record with Joe Bwarie which was a lot of fun. And he wanted to do “I Only Have Eyes for You.” And he wanted it to sound like a pop record. And I love Bruno Mars. So I worked on the arrangement for three weeks until I came up with the idea. I worked on the song for three weeks, and I finally came up with it. And I think the record is absolutely sensational, although very few people will hear it. But it was a Bruno Mars’ style. And I also took The Flamingos’ thing, and the way I put it…
together it’s a totally different record, different song, but it was something like I said I don’t have it yet.
